The diameter of the lens is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>. An eye is placed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> to the right of the lens and a distance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi></math> below the principal axis. The maximum value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi></math> to see the image is. (assume paraxial approximation to be valid here)
